entry_fields.selection: proposed | confirmed | rejected; rationale and evidence
entry_fields.target: Service/account/project/repository reference; explicitly unknown if unresolved
entry_fields.permission_scope: Minimum required operations, target scope and expiry
entry_fields.allocation: Confirmed project allocation, spend and usage limits, evidence
entry_fields.auth_method: Credential, scoped identity, membership or configured connection
entry_fields.configuration_names: Required variable or connection names; no values
entry_fields.access_reference: Authorized configured connection or secure-store reference; never a secret
entry_fields.intended_destination: Where access should be configured and how it binds to its consumer; proposed is not configured
entry_fields.authorization: not required | pending | approved | denied; operation/scope and evidence
entry_fields.availability: not configured | configured, unverified | verified | unavailable | expired | revoked
entry_fields.verification: not run | passed | failed; permitted check, environment, date and nonsecret evidence
entry_fields.dependencies: Milestone IDs, independent work and next action

request_fields.request: Purpose, target/environment, minimum permission or setup, destination, responsible person, allocation limit and affected milestone
request_fields.decision: Actual user response and authorized scope; pending when unanswered
request_fields.verification: Authorized capability check and nonsecret outcome
request_fields.alternative: What happens if declined/delayed; work that can continue
